# Knuckleball / The Baller League

> Knuckleball (Knuckleball Global Pvt Ltd) is a sports ecosystem that develops football competitions, communities and experiences in India. It is the parent organisation of The Baller League (flagship competitive football league) and Baller Club (football community and learning initiative).

## Core pages

- [Home](/index.html): The Baller League Season 2: competition overview, teams, standings and registration.
- [Competition](/competition.html): Match centre, fixtures, results and league standings for Baller League Season 2.
- [Players](/players.html): All Baller League Season 2 team squads and player profiles.
- [Media](/media.html): Match highlights, full-match replays, photography and social feeds from @knuckleball.in.
- [Shop](/shop.html): Baller League content services: highlight edits, player portraits, team films and editions.
- [Blog](/blog.html): Season 2 stories, match reports and editorial content.
- [Matchday 1 recap](/news-matchday-1-recap.html): Every Group A result and scorer, standings and top scorers after the opening round.
- [WLWG FC 4-2 Walkalone](/news-wlwg-comeback.html): Match report on WLWG's comeback from 2-0 down.
- [Bangalore Grafters 10-2 Walkalone](/news-bangalore-grafters-10-2.html): Adnan's four-goal match report and Group A table impact.
- [Group B Matchday 1 recap](/news-group-b-matchday-1-recap.html): All eight Group B results, every scorer, the table and the key numbers.
- [Darshan's eight goals](/news-darshan-eight-goals-legacy-ffa.html): Legacy FFA's number 7 and the early lead in the Season 02 scoring chart.
- [Passion FC start 2-0](/news-passion-fc-two-wins.html): Dilsher's hat-trick, a 4-3 win over Veltrix and a 4-1 win over Crescents.
- [United 5's 4-1 Falcons FC](/news-united-5s-4-1-falcons.html): Yashwanth's double, an own goal and what it means for Group B.
- [Crescents FC 3-2 First Touch FC](/news-crescents-first-touch-3-2.html): Sanjay's double and Muied's brace in a five-goal Group B match.
- [How the Baller League works](/news-baller-league-format-explained.html): Season 02 format, groups, points, goal-difference tiebreaks and scorer rules.
